2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North‑West Frontier Province Local Government
Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 26th July, 2001]
No. Legis.
1(18)70‑VIII. 3808, dated 26‑7‑2001.‑‑The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province
is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
North‑West Frontier Province Local Government Elections (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2001:
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province

2.
Substitution of section 9 of N.‑W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.‑‑In
the North‑West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000 (N.‑W.F.P. Ordinance VI of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, for section 9, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"9. Special
Minority Seats.‑‑In a union where the population of minorities
is in excess of ten percent. of the
total population of the union, reserved seats for minority communities mentioned in the preceding section shall
be allocated in the manner
prescribed by Government."

3. Amendment

appearing at the end shall be replaced by a colon and thereafter the following

5. Amendment
of section 15 of N.‑W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.‑‑In
the said Ordinance for section 15, the following shall be substituted, namely:
" 15.
Proceeding against defaulters.‑‑Whoever‑‑
(a) is found by
the Chief Election Commissioner to have contravened the provisions of section 14 shall stand disqualified from
being a candidate for election to a local
Government for a period of four years; or
(b) having been
elected as a member of local Government or being holder of an elective office of local Government
is found by the Chief Election Commissioner to
have contravened the provisions of section 14 shall cease forthwith to be an elected member or to hold the office of
such member and stand disqualified from being
a candidate for election to a local Government for a period of four
years."

No. Legis.
1(18)70‑VIII. 3808, dated 26‑7‑2001.‑‑The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province
is hereby published for general information:‑‑
6.
Amendment of section 16 of N.‑W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.‑‑In
the said Ordinance in section 16,‑‑
(i) in
subsection (2), for the words "the highest number", the words mid
figure "more than 50%" shall
be substituted; and
(ii) for
subsection (3), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(3) In
case a Zilla Nazim and a Naib Zilla Nazim or a Town Nazim and a Naib Town Nazim or a Tehsil Nazim and a
Naib Tehsil Nazim do not secure more than 50%
of the total votes of the members of the union councils in the respective district, town or tehsil, there shall be
held a fresh election, within one week of the first
election, in. which the joint candidates for such offices securing the highest and the second highest number of votes shall
be the contestants, and the joint candidates
securing the highest number of votes in the fresh election shall be declared elected."
